//: ONE config for BOTH Vercel projects. The admin control center
(`admin.merodeutsch.pramods.com.np`) and the learner app
(`merodeutsch.pramods.com.np`) are separate projects on the same repo,
branch and `npm run build`, so both read THIS file. An earlier draft
kept a second `vercel.admin.json`; two files that both look authoritative
is exactly the drift this file was meant to prevent, so it is gone.
-- WHY THE RULES ARE HOST-GATED --
A Vercel rewrite is scoped to a PROJECT, not a hostname, so a single
project could not express 'index.html on merodeutsch, admin.html on
admin.merodeutsch'. Splitting into two projects solves that, but leaves
the opposite problem: one file has to be correct for both.
It is, because each project only ever receives requests for its OWN
hostname. The host conditions are therefore an ASSERTION, not a
dispatcher: on the learner project they never match and the catch-all
wins; on the admin project they match and the admin document is served.
The conditions are also what keep the admin security headers off the
learner app -- X-Robots-Tag: noindex applied unconditionally would
deindex the entire product.
-- ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING --
Rewrites are evaluated top to bottom and the first match wins:
1. /admin.html passes through, so the catch-all cannot swallow it and
hand a learner the admin shell.
2. The host-gated catch-all serves admin.html for every admin path --
required because the control center is a BrowserRouter SPA, so a
deep link like /users must boot the admin DOCUMENT.
3. The host-gated /sw.js deny, then the learner catch-all.
Service-worker responses are forced to revalidate so a deploy can never
be masked by a cached sw.js -- the usual cause of 'PWA not updating'.
